recipes.name: Incredible Vegan Feta
instructions: Add all of the ingredients to a blender and blend until creamy.
Transfer the mixture to an airtight container and store in the fridge for at least 3 hours, or ideally overnight. The longer it sits in the fridge, the more firm and crumbly the texture will become.
Crumble as desired over any dish, such as on salads. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Refined coconut oil is coconut oil that doesn't smell or taste like coconuts. Using refined coconut oil is preferred to unrefined as the feta retains a more neutral flavour.
Storage Store in an airtight container for up to 5 days.
